purpose: Attach the QR reporter to the cloud kernel that carries patch 0006, and trace past the TTBR1 switch for the first time

chain.note: This delivery is the first one whose kernel was built by the cloud run that actually applied 0006; every earlier image was built from a kernel that predates it.

patch_0006_proof_in_machine_code.note: A listed patch is not a compiled patch. These checks read the built image.
patch_0006_proof_in_machine_code.explanation: Total size is unchanged because the added work was absorbed by existing segment slack; 7,297,495 bytes differ and 5,650 symbols shifted by +0x10, so the image is not a stale reuse.

probe.reporter_strings: 25 enter + 25 return, one per trace point

why_post_switch_tracing_is_now_sound.before: The reporter's __KDIAG segment lived in an unmapped gap, so any code after the switch would abort at its first byte. prepare_early_report.py therefore refused to place a trace there.
why_post_switch_tracing_is_now_sound.now: Patch 0006 maps the segment named by tb-diag-segment RX during arm_vm_prot_init, which runs before the switch. The trace point after the switch is safe only while that mapping is requested and present.
why_post_switch_tracing_is_now_sound.guard: --trace-past-switch is refused unless the caller opts in explicitly

payload.adt_note: macOS identity ADT (model Mac17,11), not the hardware one
payload.boot_args: -v serial=3 ramoops=0xac340000 ramoops_size=0x40000 ramoops_ecc=0 ramoops_panic_delay=15 ramoops_reset_after=120 tb-diag-segment=__KDIAG

verification.signer_self_report: PASS, 22 other raw descriptors and the public key unchanged
verification.independent_rsa: PASS on vbmeta.img and on the vendor_boot footer, recomputed from the embedded modulus without avbtool
verification.independent_payload: PASS: kernel decodes to 91b078f4..., ADT f4161ff9..., toml 2a5d399d...
verification.production_darwinboot_parser: PASS on the control kernel and on the probe kernel
verification.boot_arg_cross_check: the argument names __KDIAG and the kernel really has that segment

parallel_track_b_adt_window.conclusion: fixing the ADT window cannot make the ramoops PA reachable
parallel_track_b_adt_window.candidate_a_excluded_ranges: IMPOSSIBLE. arm_vm_excluded_init clamps each entry to the span (end=min(end,span_end), base=max(base,gPhysBase)); an entry below physBase yields base>=end and is skipped. Expressable bytes of the ramoops range: 0.
parallel_track_b_adt_window.candidate_b_larger_window: IMPOSSIBLE. The span starts at physBase, which is 32.3 GiB above the ramoops PA; lengthening the span never reaches below its own start.
parallel_track_b_adt_window.candidate_c_move_window_down: Changes gPhysBase/virtBase and every linked address: a port rebuild, not a fix.
parallel_track_b_adt_window.workable_alternative: Reserve a log region inside the span (about 1879.9 MiB of headroom exists). An excluded entry there is accepted, so the buffer becomes reachable at all - which the ramoops PA never was. It still cannot capture a stop inside arm_vm_init by itself.

boundary: Diagnostic image, not a functional fix and not hardware acceptance.
The reporter appends 835,584 B and rewrites 25 call sites; layout perturbation is expected and the switch site moved by 0x88.
The post-switch trace point proves the mapping works only if the device boots with tb-diag-segment=__KDIAG, which this image carries.
No device flash, reboot or partition operation was performed by the agent.
